changes.to: Official URL is the 钢镚 L2 page, whose spec table lists L2 (point-foot), L2-W (wheel-legged) and L2-W Ultra; values here are L2-W. Limit speed 5 m/s; payload ≈16 kg (150 kg static). '¥39,999 起' on page is the L2 family starting price, not specific to L2-W, so price left null. 756 Wh battery stated on page (spec table lists 15000 mAh). Re-checked 2026-11-17: the L2 product page (opened) carries a per-variant spec table with an explicit L2-W column - standing 760x450x500 mm, prone 780x550x190 mm, 27 kg with battery, ~16 kg continuous payload (150 kg static), 3.7 m/s max / 5 m/s limit, 25 cm continuous stairs, 40 deg slope, 5.5 h no-load / 3.5 h full-load, 20 km / 12 km range, 756 Wh (15000 mAh), 1.5 h charge, 12 joint motors / 95 N.m, 4G, UWB, stereo camera, IP66, -20~55 C. CORRECTION: LiDAR and GNSS/RTK are NOT in the L2-W column (the 96-line LiDAR x2 and RTK are L2-W Ultra only), so they were removed from sensors; dof filled with the 12 joint motors. The page's marketing copy ('RoamerX ... LiDAR + GNSS', '720 deg fusion sensing') describes the family, not the L2-W configuration.
